name: qkd_seq_core_st_r1

pin_regs.reason: Every input is captured at its pin (rv/rk/rb, kvv/ktg/cd, lpr/lpl/lpt, sv, ov/og/ob, crq/afq/mfq) except the Q store push x_v, which is registered directly from the att_rx pins so it stays aligned with the payload on the KVN data wires (the store slices capture both at their own pins); every output is a register. The compiled timeline (aq start 47 edges after the CMD pin edge, tools/qwen_static_kv/seq_static_golden.py G_AQ) counts these stages; a flow-inserted stage would break the store alignment.

job.purpose: Q-KVSYS PVJOIN 10-16 (lead-approved qkd_seq retirement): static control leaf of qkd_seq_static. Every store pop / aq start / Q beat / posted row / stream descriptor at a fixed edge after the compiled CMD slot of the static D2D end (link compiler), arrivals off-slot fault, landing row credits only checked. Bench: qkd_seq_static (this leaf + closed qkd_seq_xs_tp8 x4 + qkd_seq_fan x4) vs legacy qkd_seq on 36 link-slotted layers: aq 1188 / kvn 72 / kc 72 words per quadrant bit-identical, aq start at the compiled CMD+47 every layer (legacy +1 edge earlier, rows equal); mutants Q-beat swap / row t / start late / KVN push early FAIL.
